Source.evidence_source: [008_selfreport_coping_scale_causey_amp_dubow_1992] Children are asked to indicate how often they use each strategy to cope with a specific problem

MedCat.evidence_source: [008_selfreport_coping_scale_causey_amp_dubow_1992] Five scales have been derived based on factor analyses and include two approach scales (seeking social support, problem-solving) and three avoidance scales (distancing, internalizing, and externalizing).
